**Optional H3 SLA**

The normal workflow uses `Attention = Default` and does not require the external SLA backend. To use the former SLA recipe, set **H3 Optimizations → Attention = H3 SLA** and **FP16 accumulation = Disabled**. The SLA controls default to sparsity `0.90`, block `64`, minimum sequence `4096`, one dense final step, protected audio and `comfy_kitchen` dense backend.

Source LoRAs are restored first; Optimizations stay before Sigma Shift and sampling. The selected optimization profile is written into the result packet.
nodes.title: Optional SLA profile (external backend only when selected)
